_comment: D4 (operator ruling 2026-10-02) - the formulation gate's data. A criterion may not be
judged as MET by anything unless it carries, HERE, the frozen judgedScale it is stated at,
its minFeaturePx (the smallest feature the product's pipeline can still paint at that
scale), and a deterministic metric term per binding predicate. The corpus gate
(test/unit/byok_border_corpus.test.js) rejects: a missing entry, a missing field, a
demand below minFeaturePx, a feature the print decoration pipeline crops away, and a
binding predicate with no deterministic metric (D4's four rejection clauses).
`metric: null` is NOT a pass - it is the honest declaration that the criterion's binding
predicates are gestalt prose (or a shape the pipeline does not paint), so per D2 the
criterion is VOID for binding purposes and per D5 nothing may be published or frozen while
such an entry exists. Only 01-gilded-frame has a metric today, because only it received a
clause whose predicates are shape/continuity/coverage - the exact class D2 assigns to the
metric. The rest stay VOID until each is re-cut the same way; inventing thresholds for
prose criteria would be the vacuous pass this gate exists to prevent.

01-gilded-frame.reason: Operator ruling D1: 01's original criterion is vacated as unverifiable at the judged scale (its two rules are measured present at 95.5-99.0% line coverage and its four corner marks at +41/+22/+32/+19 px over an identical control, yet the seat denies both), so the binding verdict moves to this metric and the seat becomes corroborating. The thresholds are the consultants' converged clause (per-edge coverage >= 90% for two parallel rules; corner mark delta >= 15 device px) with one correction the measurement forced: the corner term is stated as a delta against a CONTROL box on the same rails, because an absolute ink threshold is satisfiable by rail thickness alone (measured: a design with no corner artwork carries 200-340 inked px in the same-size box).

04-dragon-scale.reason: Operator ruling D3 (2026-10-05), clause = the converged wording of phase4_five_decisions_proposal.md section 5, measured basis phase4_d3_measurements_20261004.md (reproduced 2026-10-05 on 1577133): AC-V1-c is superseded ONLY for 04/11/05; closure is judged per edge on the judged 2x print capture after the actual border-image-repeat: round rail scaling, which is ANISOTROPIC (~0.146 px/unit horizontal vs ~0.923 vertical on 656x1920) so square-source-unit closure cannot hold on the rails. Round-27 readings: paintedSpan 0.9773/0.9773/0.9919/0.9919, interior gaps 0, stroke p50 rails 6/6, stiles 2/6. The rail/stile minima are the operator's 2026-10-05 ruling (rails >= 3, stiles >= 1.5); the draft's example numbers (rails >= 1.5, stiles >= 3) were REJECTED because they would fail 04's LEFT stile at p50 2px. assumeSquareSourceUnits: false; no four-edge continuity required; corners judged separately as corner marks.

branch.route: formulation gate -> ONE --border-img generation -> fresh judged capture -> binding metric on the new cell
branch.onMetricFailure: retire (canonical: false); its superseded variant already exists; the criterion is NOT amended to fit
branch.measuredBasis: Round-6 artwork FAILS on the round-27 cell: paintedSpan 0.8061/0.0348/0.1438/0.0208 (all four edges below the 0.85 floor), interior gaps 8/839/334/2063 (TOP's gap sits exactly AT the <= 8 threshold; its coverage fails regardless). Operator answer 2026-10-05: regenerate once, then retire if the metric fails.

05-celestial-arcs.reason: Operator ruling D3 (2026-10-05), clause = the converged wording of phase4_five_decisions_proposal.md section 5: 05's coverage floor is 0.85 (not 0.90) and it additionally requires a solid arc stroke >= 8 device px (depth-run share >= 8px on the round-27 cell: TOP 131/1475, BOTTOM 14/58, LEFT 425/726, RIGHT 27/103 - partially satisfiable; binding = every term passes). The measured FAIL on the round-6 artwork routes 05 to the clause's own regeneration-then-retire branch, which the operator confirmed 2026-10-05. The round-6 bytes stay canonical until the regenerated artwork is judged.
